visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. Complete original STRAT casino/hotel/tower exterior retains the exact whole-complex outline,separate350m tower projection,75m bent hotel slab,lower pool-wing and mapped free-form rooftop pool. Tower centerX15.5,Z73.75 lies toward+Z/ESE/Las Vegas Boulevard;the hotel court opens-Z/NW. Three tapering concrete supports preserve actual lower and upper open gaps around the central shaft/circular entrance drum. Dark sloping observation pod,lower diagonal lattice cone,terraces,red-white mast and thin350m tip support recognition. Hotel white horizontal floor bands were strengthened during visual iteration;all24 reconstructed rows remain in district/near levels. Broad curved casino frontage,connected roof surfaces,static sign and schematic roof plant complete the resort. Detailed master retains pane recess returns,fine mullions,denser pod/mast lattice and roof louvers. Four browser tiers preserve the full complex,with fewer far facets and aggregated rail/roof/mast detail. Five existing256px shared concrete,window-grid,painted-metal,membrane and granite graphs plus palette pool water use no private or embedded images. Glazing and pool are stylized opaque surfaces. Four focused tests prove byte-exact source reconstruction,signed whole-complex placement,native embedded foundations/leg feet,representative hotel/pool heights,actual lower/upper support gaps,350m tip and exact tier budgets/separate GPU streams. The actual production viewer replaces six real resort map components while retaining five native neighbors,including the adjacent25m parking garage. Unmodified129x129/4m native field oversamples two ordinary global terrain tiles. Base622m,casino14m and pool-wing24m heights,pod/leg sections,threefold leg rotation,pane/floor counts,roof machinery,entrance details and original site/curb grades are reconstructed approximations. The static simplified mast carriage suggests the Big Shot platform;there is no ride simulation or operating-state claim,and historical external green ride arms were not copied. Portable fallback surfaces differ from bound viewer graphs. Generic synthetic street/block cameras show only part of the shaft or pod;custom full-resort and detail views establish whole-model and four-tier coverage. Minor shadow/LOD/facet differences and physical-device timing remain unmeasured.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and two ordinary global Terrarium tiles;no bespoke survey/terrain source.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Native field is unmodified. Complete podium skirts,individual tower leg feet and the circular entry drum embed below it. Base622m is rounded from the tower-center sample and remains approximate. Actual foundation,curb,accessible entry gradients and landscaping are unsurveyed. Six actual resort map components are replaced in the production viewer fixture;five nearby native buildings,including the separate25m parking garage,remain.
